The-locked-front-door-of-the-Hornbill-Observatory-looms-ahead, a-monument-to-the-scientist's-disappearance. To-the-east, the-maintenance-path-slopes-away-into-the-shadows-of-the-trees, its-gravel-crushed-and-settled. The-mystery-of-the-missing-scientist-feels-tangible-here, anchored-in-the-rust-and-shadows-of-the-observatory's-walls.
